import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
plt.xkcd()
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(2,1, figsize=(8,8))
fig.suptitle("Concealed under-deck TMD - zero deck change")
ax1.set_title("Cross-section: deck clear, hardware below soffit")
ax1.plot([0,10],[5,5], lw=4)
ax1.text(3.5,5.2,"deck top unchanged", fontsize=8)
ax1.plot([2,8],[4,4], color="gray", lw=3)
ax1.text(3,4.3,"clamp beam", fontsize=7)
ax1.plot([3,3],[4,5], color="black"); ax1.plot([7,7],[4,5], color="black")
ax1.text(0.5,4.4,"U-bolt", fontsize=7)
ax1.plot([4,4],[2,4], color="blue"); ax1.plot([6,6],[2,4], color="blue")
ax1.text(3.2,3,"spring", fontsize=7); ax1.text(6.2,3,"damper", fontsize=7)
r1=mpatches.Rectangle((3.5,1),3,1, fc="gray", ec="black")
ax1.add_patch(r1)
ax1.text(4,1.4,"250kg mass", fontsize=8)
ax1.plot([3.5,6.5],[0.7,0.7], linestyle="--", color="red")
ax1.text(3,0.3,"access hatch from below", fontsize=7)
ax1.set_ylim(0,7.5); ax1.axis("off")
ax2.set_title("Long-section 40m: twin units at midspan")
ax2.plot([0,40],[5,5], lw=4)
ax2.plot([0,0],[0,5], lw=2); ax2.plot([40,40],[0,5], lw=2)
ax2.text(15,5.5,"deck top unchanged", fontsize=8)
r2=mpatches.Rectangle((18,3.5),4,1, fc="gray", ec="black")
ax2.add_patch(r2)
ax2.text(18.2,3.9,"2x TMD below soffit", fontsize=7)
ax2.plot([20,20],[0,3.5], linestyle="--", color="red")
ax2.text(20.5,1,"midspan antinode", fontsize=7)
ax2.set_ylim(0,7); ax2.axis("off")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("sketch.png", dpi=150)
print("sketch ok")
